  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.record-form h3 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.form-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.form-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.form-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.form-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.15);
}

.form-hint {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Relationship Explorer */
.relationship-explorer {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.relationship-explorer h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.section-hint {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.relationship-filters {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.relationship-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.relationship-card {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
}

.relationship-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.relationship-card-from {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.relationship-card-arrow {
  color: var(--cyan);
  font-weight: bold;
}

.relationship-card-to {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.relationship-card-type {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.relationship-card-stats {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Change Request Panel */
.change-request-panel {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.change-request-panel h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.change-request-item {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.change-request-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.change-request-target {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.change-request-reason {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.change-request-proposed {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--cyan);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.change-request-actions-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

.change-request-actions-row .btn {
  flex: 1;
}

/* Sources */
.source-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.source-form h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.sources-list {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.sources-list h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.source-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-sm) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.source-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.source-type {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

/* Governance */
.decision-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.decision-form h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.decisions-list {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.decisions-list h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.decision-item {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.decision-item:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.decision-item h5 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.decision-item p {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.decision-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Import / Export */
.import-export-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.import-export-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.import-export-card h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

/* Prompt builder */
.prompt-builder-notice {
  max-width: var(--max-width);
}

.prompt-builder {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.prompt-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.prompt-form h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.prompt-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.prompt-preview {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.prompt-preview h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.preview-badge {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--green);
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

.preview-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.preview-card {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.preview-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.preview-card p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.jsx-preview {
  background: #0d1117;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--cyan);
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-height: 300px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

/* Import / Export detailed */
.import-export-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.import-export-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.import-export-card h4 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

/* Review item */
.review-item {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.review-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.review-rationale {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.review-target {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.review-state {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--cyan);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.review-claim {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Claims section */
.claims-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(400px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.claim-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.claim-card-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.claim-card-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  flex: 1;
}

.claim-card-main h4 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.claim-card-main .claim-entity {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.claim-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.claim-version {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--cyan);
}

.claim-created {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.claim-status {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.claim-card-body {
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.claim-versions,
.claim-proposals {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.claim-version-item,
.claim-proposal-item,
.claim-review-item {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  padding: var(--space-sm) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.claim-version-item:last-child,
.claim-proposal-item:last-child,
.claim-review-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.claim-version-number {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--cyan);
}

.claim-version-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.claim-version-type {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.claim-form-section {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.claim-form-section h3 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

/* Analytics Dashboard */
.analytics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.analytics-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.analytics-card h3 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.chart-wrapper {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  height: 200px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
}

.chart-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

.chart-legend span {
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.analytics-summary {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}

.analytics-summary h3 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.summary-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.summary-value {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--cyan);
}

.summary-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-align: center;
}
.footer {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-lg);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}


/* After Humanity sample portal */
.sample-world-section {
  padding: 24px var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 92% 18%, rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.12), transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #10192c, #0b1222 70%);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.sample-portal {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #0a1221;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.sample-portal-header {
  min-height: 74px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  padding: 12px 22px;
  background: rgba(6, 12, 23, 0.96);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.sample-portal-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--text);
}

.sample-portal-brand:hover { text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); }

.sample-portal-mark {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.sample-portal-brand strong,
.sample-portal-brand small {
  display: block;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.sample-portal-brand strong {
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.sample-portal-brand small {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.13em;
  font-size: 0.53rem;
}

.sample-portal-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: clamp(10px, 1.6vw, 24px);
}

.sample-portal-nav a {
  padding: 7px 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  color: #b7c2d5;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sample-portal-nav a:hover,
.sample-portal-nav a.is-current {
  color: var(--gold);
  border-bottom-color: var(--gold);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.sample-portal-explore {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 13px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(223, 187, 112, 0.5);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.sample-portal-explore:hover { background: rgba(223, 187, 112, 0.1); text-decoration: none; }

.sample-portal-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 218px minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 720px;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar {
  padding: 24px 14px;
  background: rgba(5, 11, 21, 0.72);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.sample-portal-label {
  margin: 2px 10px 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar > a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  padding: 11px 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text);
}

.sample-portal-sidebar > a:hover {
  background: rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.08);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar > a > span:first-child {
  flex: 0 0 27px;
  color: var(--gold);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar strong,
.sample-portal-sidebar small {
  display: block;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar strong {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.sample-portal-sidebar small {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.63rem;
}

.sample-portal-main { min-width: 0; padding: 18px; }

.sample-portal-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 340px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  border: 1px solid rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #1a2440;
}

.sample-portal-hero-art {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -2;
}

.sample-portal-hero-art::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(6, 11, 22, 0.97) 0%, rgba(7, 13, 25, 0.84) 40%, rgba(8, 13, 23, 0.1) 100%),
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7, 14, 25, 0.52), transparent 60%);
}

.sample-portal-hero-art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

.sample-portal-hero-copy {
  max-width: 540px;
  padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 54px);
}

.sample-portal-kicker {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.17em;
}

.sample-portal-hero h1 {
  margin: 12px 0 4px;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.15rem, 4vw, 3.6rem);
  letter-spacing: 0.045em;
  line-height: 1.02;
}

.sample-portal-subtitle {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sample-portal-hero-copy > p:not(.sample-portal-kicker):not(.sample-portal-subtitle) {
  max-width: 440px;
  color: #d0d8e5;
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.sample-portal-hero-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.sample-portal-hero-link:hover { background: rgba(223, 187, 112, 0.12); text-decoration: none; }

.sample-portal-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: clamp(28px, 7vw, 86px);
  padding: 15px 22px 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.sample-portal-stats div { display: grid; }
.sample-portal-stats strong { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.1; }
.sample-portal-stats span { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.65rem; }

.sample-portal-content {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 240px;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.sample-category-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 9px;
  scroll-margin-top: 96px;
}

.sample-category-card {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 230px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 18%, rgba(104, 159, 214, 0.32), transparent 44%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(36, 57, 88, 0.7), #10192a 82%);
  transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}

.sample-category-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: rgba(223, 187, 112, 0.65);
  color: var(--text);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.sample-card-characters { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 22%, rgba(220, 143, 153, .34), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(180deg, #312738, #10192a 82%); }
.sample-card-factions { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 22%, rgba(183, 112, 220, .34), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(180deg, #292341, #10192a 82%); }
.sample-card-lore { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 22%, rgba(94, 145, 229, .38), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(180deg, #1e2946, #10192a 82%); }
.sample-card-gallery { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 22%, rgba(74, 197, 183, .32), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(180deg, #193b43, #10192a 82%); }

.sample-category-icon {
  width: 100%;
  height: 105px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: rgba(232, 219, 190, 0.9);
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 3.7rem;
  text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(89, 209, 255, 0.48);
}

.sample-category-card h2 { margin: 5px 0 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.sample-category-card p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.sample-card-arrow { align-self: flex-end; margin-top: auto; color: var(--gold); }

.sample-updates {
  padding: 14px 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(18, 28, 45, 0.92);
}

.sample-updates-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.sample-updates-heading h2 {
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sample-updates-heading a { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.62rem; white-space: nowrap; }

.sample-update {
  display: flex;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 10px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
  color: var(--text);
}

.sample-update:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; }

.sample-update-orb {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex: 0 0 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(89, 209, 255, .25), rgba(223, 187, 112, .2));
  color: var(--gold);
}

.sample-update small,
.sample-update strong,
.sample-update time { display: block; }

.sample-update small { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.52rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.sample-update strong { margin: 2px 0; font-size: 0.65rem; line-height: 1.25; }
.sample-update time { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.56rem; }

.sample-updates blockquote {
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: #c9b994;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 0.69rem;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.sample-updates cite {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.52rem;
  font-style: normal;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-align: right;
}

.sample-portal-footer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 15px 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(20, 38, 60, .95), rgba(12, 20, 34, .9));
}

.sample-portal-footer p { color: var(--cyan); font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.sample-portal-footer span { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .68rem; }
.sample-portal-footer strong { color: var(--text); }
.sample-portal-footer a { font-size: .65rem; white-space: nowrap; }

@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  .sample-portal-header { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .sample-portal-nav { order: 3; width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; }
  .sample-portal-content { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 220px; }
  .sample-category-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(130px, 1fr)); }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .sample-world-section { padding: 12px 8px var(--space-2xl); }
  .sample-portal-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sample-portal-sidebar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; padding: 12px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .sample-portal-label { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .sample-portal-sidebar > a { padding: 9px 6px; }
  .sample-portal-sidebar strong { font-size: .68rem; }
  .sample-portal-sidebar small { font-size: .57rem; }
  .sample-portal-main { padding: 10px; }
  .sample-portal-hero { min-height: 330px; }
  .sample-portal-hero-copy { padding: 24px; }
  .sample-portal-content { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sample-category-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .sample-category-card { min-height: 190px; }
  .sample-category-icon { height: 82px; }
  .sample-updates { margin-top: 2px; }
  .sample-portal-footer { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .sample-portal-header { padding: 10px 12px; }
  .sample-portal-explore { display: none; }
  .sample-portal-hero { min-height: 390px; }
  .sample-portal-hero-art::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(6, 11, 22, .95), rgba(7, 13, 25, .58)), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7, 14, 25, .62), transparent 70%); }
  .sample-portal-hero h1 { font-size: 2.05rem; }
  .sample-portal-stats { gap: 15px; padding: 13px 12px; }
  .sample-portal-stats span { max-width: 86px; font-size: .57rem; }
  .sample-category-grid { gap: 7px; }
  .sample-category-card { min-height: 175px; padding: 10px; }
  .sample-category-icon { height: 66px; font-size: 3rem; }
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .data-notice {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: var(--space-md);
  }

  .navbar {
    padding: 12px var(--space-sm);
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: var(--space-md);
    gap: var(--space-sm);
  }

  .nav-links.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  .hero {
    padding: 100px var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg);
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }

  .hero-buttons {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .dashboard-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .prompt-builder {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .search-filter {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .search-input {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .records-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .relationship-item {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
  }

  .stat-value {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
  }

  .dashboard-section {
    padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-sm) var(--space-2xl);
  }
}

/* Accessibility: focus states */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--cyan);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}



.after-humanity-video-section {
  padding: 3.5rem 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0b1222 0%, #111a2d 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(117, 149, 188, 0.2);
}
.after-humanity-video-heading { margin: 0 auto 1.5rem; max-width: 900px; text-align: center; }
.after-humanity-video-heading .eyebrow { color: #59d1ff; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; }
.after-humanity-video-heading h2 { margin: 0.65rem 0; color: #edf4ff; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.3rem); }
.after-humanity-video-heading p { color: #aab8cd; }
.after-humanity-video-frame { position: relative; width: min(100%, 960px); aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; margin: 0 auto; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(94, 211, 255, 0.35); border-radius: 18px; background: #050914; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); }
.after-humanity-video-frame iframe { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
.after-humanity-video-link { display: block; width: fit-content; margin: 1rem auto 0; color: #61d6ff; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
.after-humanity-video-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .after-humanity-video-section { padding: 2.5rem 1rem; }
  .after-humanity-video-frame { border-radius: 12px; }
}
